# Traceability matrix (generated by `npm run trace:write`)

"Proven by" lists tests that run in the fast suite. "E2E flows" are Maestro flows that run only on an emulator in CI; they are listed for navigation and are not counted as proof by the gate.

| Requirement | Text | Proven by | E2E flows |
|---|---|---|---|
| REQ-AUTHZ-001 | Only an active member of a vessel's crew shall be able to create drill records for that vessel. | `tests/rules/drills.rules.test.ts` |  |
| REQ-AUTHZ-002 | Drill records shall be append-only: no one shall be able to update or delete them. | `tests/rules/drills.rules.test.ts` |  |
| REQ-AUTHZ-003 | A user shall not be able to read the drill records of a vessel they are not an active crew member of. | `tests/rules/drills.rules.test.ts` |  |
| REQ-DRILL-001 | The app shall persist every recorded drill on the device before it makes any network call. | `tests/unit/queue.test.ts` |  |
| REQ-DRILL-002 | When a drill is recorded, the app shall assign it a unique id that does not change across retries. | `tests/unit/queue.test.ts` |  |
| REQ-DRILL-003 | If the network is unavailable, then the app shall keep the drill pending and shall not report it as synchronised. | `tests/component/DrillScreen.test.tsx`<br>`tests/unit/httpTransport.test.ts`<br>`tests/unit/queue.test.ts` | `.maestro/02_offline_then_online.yaml` |
| REQ-DRILL-004 | When connectivity returns, the app shall send pending drills in the order they were recorded. | `tests/component/DrillScreen.test.tsx`<br>`tests/unit/queue.test.ts` | `.maestro/02_offline_then_online.yaml` |
| REQ-DRILL-005 | The gateway shall create at most one drill record per id, however many times that id is submitted. | `tests/api/gateway.test.ts` |  |
| REQ-DRILL-006 | If the gateway stores a drill but the reply is lost, then the retry shall leave exactly one stored record and the app shall then mark the drill synchronised. | `tests/api/gateway.test.ts`<br>`tests/unit/httpTransport.test.ts`<br>`tests/unit/queue.test.ts` | `.maestro/03_lost_reply_retry.yaml` |
| REQ-DRILL-007 | If the gateway refuses a drill permanently, then the app shall mark it rejected, shall not retry it automatically, and shall show the reason. | `tests/api/gateway.test.ts`<br>`tests/unit/httpTransport.test.ts`<br>`tests/unit/queue.test.ts` |  |
| REQ-DRILL-008 | While a drill is pending or rejected, the app shall display it distinctly from synchronised drills. | `tests/component/DrillScreen.test.tsx` |  |
| REQ-DRILL-009 | If a drill has missing or malformed fields, then the app shall refuse it and shall not persist it. | `tests/unit/queue.test.ts` |  |
